name: The Bodgers

rules.name: Taped on
rules.text: Everything a Bodger owns is taped to them somewhere: a Bodger has **4 Belt slots** instead of 3.

rules.name: First on the scene
rules.text: When a pod lands (the round 2 pod or a scenario's own), every Bodger may at once move up to **half their Move** toward it.

rules.name: Share the charge
rules.text: A Bodger in base contact with an ally may move **1 Energy** from one of their batteries to the other, as a Use action.

rules.name: Hang on, mate
rules.text: When an ally within 4 inches of a Bodger is put down, the Bodger may use their reaction to Move up to 2 inches toward them.

subfactions.name: Red Tape
subfactions.rule: **Claim pending.** Before deployment, file a claim on one scenario item, crate or terrain piece: an enemy who picks it up or uses it is **Announced** (the paperwork follows them)

subfactions.name: Silver Tape
subfactions.rule: **Showroom condition.** The crew's copy items never bodge: a kept total of exactly 2 jams them like any total of 3 or less, and the bodge table is not rolled. A Silver Tape fighter who clears a jam in view of an enemy is **Under warranty**: restored gear comes with a sticker, and the audience loves a restoration

subfactions.name: Black Tape
subfactions.rule: **Hot item.** Black Tape fighters have **+1 die on attacks** against an enemy who carries a crate, a drop item or a scenario item. The prize is worth money, and they know who has it

ownTaskTable.Result: **Sold the wrong crate.** One copy weapon of the crew's choice is gone; the crew gains half its price
**Red Tape inspection.** Pay **2 parts** for a trading permit, or the fighter starts the next battle **Shook** (the forms are long)
**A crate of mystery bolts.** Roll a d6: 1 to 3, it is bolts (**+1 part**); 4 to 6, a copy item worth up to 5 parts
**A buyer for anything.** Sell one more item at full price
**A pod-chaser's tip.** The fighter gets to a pod first, behind the market, and cracks it: roll on the drop table (section 11.7). An arrival from it joins the crew as usual
**A collector's crate,** contents unknown: roll on the finds table (section 14.7)

startingKit: **Starting kit:** a repair kit, a pair of smoke grenades, a crank charger and a grapnel and line, all copies.
specials: **Specials:** the gift and Rites at the normal price (30 and 20). No bots.
captiveFate: **Captive fate: Work them.** The captive works the stall for a break: the Bodgers roll once on the flea market table below (no test), on top of half the price.
ownTask: **Own task: Work the flea market** (Nerve, Routine 6). Success: sell one item at **full price**, or buy one copy item at **half price**.

name: The Inspectorate

rules.name: The uniform
rules.text: An enemy who moves into base contact with an Inspectorate fighter makes a **Routine (6) Nerve test**; on a failure they are **Shook**. Bots and fighters with no Nerve ignore it. **Once any Inspectorate fighter goes down,** the uniform stops working for the rest of the battle: everyone has seen they bleed.

rules.name: Fines
rules.text: After each battle, the crew gains **2 parts** for each enemy fighter it put down.

rules.name: Papers, please
rules.text: At the start of each round, while the captain is standing, they inspect one enemy in line of sight within 12 inches. That enemy makes a **Tricky (8) Nerve test** or is **Announced** (their papers are out for everyone to read). Bots and fighters with no Nerve ignore it.

rules.name: Permit required
rules.text: An Inspectorate fighter may spend a Use action in base contact with a door or window to lock it with a permit (a red Hacked token). Anyone else must hack or force it open. An Inspectorate fighter passes through **any** locked door or window, whoever locked it: they have the master key.

subfactions.name: Weights and Measures
subfactions.rule: **Everything is taxed.** After a battle against them, the enemy pays the crew **2 parts** from any prize it won, and the crew gains **1 part** for each crate or item carried off by anyone

subfactions.name: Department of Improvement
subfactions.rule: **Mandatory cheer.** At the start of rounds 2, 4 and 6, one of your fighters in contact with an enemy is **Hyped** and that enemy is **Shook** (an annual review that is held in front of everyone)

subfactions.name: Fire Marshals
subfactions.rule: **Condemned.** Before deployment, mark one terrain piece as condemned: it is **Dangerous** for the whole battle (they set it on fire, for safety)

ownTaskTable.Result: **Fined a Ledgerhand.** They paid in an IOU: the task pays nothing, and the crew writes that Ledgerhands crew as a **rival**
**Fined your own clerk.** Lose **2 parts**, and the crew gains **Reliable** (to the people who pay it)
**Stamped the wrong door.** Everybody knows who did it, and the fine arrives by lunch: lose **2 parts**, and the fighter starts the next battle **Hyped**
**A fee on breathing.** If the test succeeded, the **printed pay** of the task is **doubled** (pay added by other rules, such as Paymaster, is not)
**A district holiday** in the crew's honour. The crew gains **Showboats**
**Confiscated goods.** One old-stock item the crew wants is available this break without the 4+ roll

startingKit: **Starting kit:** uniforms: the captain and one other rookie start in light armour (copy), and the crew has a pair of flash grenades (copy).
specials: **Specials:** the gift and Rites at the normal price (30 and 20). No bots.
captiveFate: **Captive fate: Fined anyway.** Refusing does not get the owner out of the fee: on top of the half price, the owner's crew pays the Inspectorate **another half of the asked price**, as much as it has.
ownTask: **Own task: Collect fees** (Fight, Tricky 8). Success: **13 parts**.

name: The Waiting

rules.name: Two hundred years of practice
rules.text: A Waiting fighter who did not Move in their last activation has **+1 die on any save** and cannot be pushed, shoved, knocked or hauled (by a Press, a hit or a clash result) until their next activation. A fighter who has yet to activate this battle counts as not having moved: they begin it waiting. They have waited two hundred years; they can wait out a bad round.

rules.name: Chanting together
rules.text: A priest of the Waiting has **+1 die** on a relic test for each Waiting ally within 2 inches (up to +2). If the test fails, the priest and each of those allies are **Announced**: the whole hymn carries (section 8.3).

rules.name: The pantheon
rules.text: The Waiting pray to all five voices: each time a fighter Asks the voice, they choose which god's table to roll (section 8.5). Each fighter of the Waiting may Ask the voice **twice per activation** (each time before a roll), praying to a **different god** each time. No subfaction rule can replace this one.

rules.name: The omen
rules.text: At the start of each round, the Waiting player rolls a d6 and sets it aside: the **omen**. Before any roll of two or more dice, a Waiting fighter's or an enemy's, the Waiting player may say so and spend it: that roll is made with one die fixed at the omen's value, the other dice rolled as usual, and the kept dice chosen as usual. A spent omen is gone, and so is an unused one at the end of the round.

subfactions.name: The Listeners
subfactions.rule: **Thought leadership.** When a fighter of the Waiting gets a **good** Ask the voice result, one ally within 3 inches is also **Hyped**

subfactions.name: The Visionaries
subfactions.rule: **Share the burden down the chain.** A Visionary psion's drain tokens may also go on allies within 12 inches of **an ally who already holds a Shook token**, not only near the psion. Each ally who ends the battle **standing and Shook** gains **+1 XP**

subfactions.name: The Pilgrims
subfactions.rule: **On the road.** When the Pilgrims fight, roll the world twice and the Pilgrims' player chooses. A battle on a world they have not fought on this season gives each Pilgrim who took part **+1 XP**

types.name: Acolyte
types.label: Acolyte
types.trait: Carries relics for a priest: a priest within 6 inches may use a relic the Acolyte holds as if they held it

types.name: Zealot
types.label: Zealot
types.trait: Fear does not stick: **ignores** the Inspectorate's uniform, a boast's terror test, the Hum-stone and **Dread** (section 8.4)

types.name: Seer
types.label: Seer
types.trait: Has **the gift** (free). A Longshanks or a Brinie only (crew limit: section 9.4)

ownTaskTable.Result: **A crisis of faith.** The fighter is **Sore**, and thinks about it
**A Visionary's seminar.** Pay **3 parts**, or the fighter misses the seminar and starts the next battle **Shook** (they did not grow)
**The gate did not wake.** It will, tomorrow. The fighter starts the next battle **Hyped**
**A relic tip.** One relic may be bought this break at half price, with no roll for a seller
**A Seer is born.** A Longshanks or Brinie of the crew without the gift may take it now, free (within the limit in section 9.4)
**The gate hums.** Nobody else heard it. The fighter gains **+2 XP**, and the crew gains a **lead**

startingKit: **Starting kit:** one relic of the player's choice worth up to 20 parts. A priest can use it only if they know its rite.
specials: **Specials:** the gift and Rites at **half price** (15 and 10; Priests and Seers have them free as types). No bots.
captiveFate: **Captive fate: Convert them.** The captive vanishes into the faith; they do not join the crew. The fighter who captured them gains **+1 XP**, and the crew gains a **lead**, on top of half the price.
ownTask: **Own task: Keep the vigil** (Nerve, Routine 6). Success: **+1 XP**, or one relic may be bought this break at half price.

name: Ledgerhands

rules.name: Pay or walk
rules.text: The crew's breaking test has **+1 die** while its parts are **10 or more**, and **-1 die** while they are **below 0**. Read the parts on the roster when the test is made.

rules.name: The mark
rules.text: Before deployment, name one enemy fighter as the **mark**. Ledgerhands fighters have **+1 die on attacks against the mark**. If the mark is down when the battle ends, the crew gains **5 parts** (the bounty on the contract).

rules.name: Hired on credit
rules.text: At creation and in any Spend step, the crew may buy and hire with parts it does not have, down to **-20**. While its parts are below 0 it buys and hires nothing more, and every part it gains pays the debt first. The air tax and recharging (section 14.3) may also be paid into debt, to the same floor of **-20**.

rules.name: Buyout
rules.text: Before deployment, if the crew has the parts, it may pay the opposing player **5 parts**: one enemy fighter of the buyer's choice does not activate in round 1 (they took a better offer). The opponent cannot refuse the money.

subfactions.name: The Indentured
subfactions.rule: **Unpaid overtime.** Once each round, one Indentured fighter may take **one extra action** in their activation, anything but an attack. They end the activation **Shook**

subfactions.name: Collections Department
subfactions.rule: **Repossession.** As a Use action in base contact with a downed enemy, take one **copy** item they carry (old-stock and drop items stay with their owner). The crew keeps it after the battle

subfactions.name: Per-Diem Companies
subfactions.rule: **On call.** The platform sends whoever is nearest. The whole crew deploys after the enemy crew has finished deploying, anywhere in its deployment zone (if both crews have On call, the first player deploys first, as usual)

ownTaskTable.Result: **The debtor was a Ledgerhand,** collecting from you: lose **3 parts**, or refuse to pay and write them as a **rival**
**Paid on the day.** The debtor pays exactly what the contract said, exactly when it said, and tells everyone. The crew gains **Oathkeepers**
**Jeminy finds a clause.** If the crew's parts are below 0, they rise by **5**; otherwise the fighter gains **+1 XP** (they read the whole contract)
**The debtor joins up** to work it off: one recruit may be hired this break for **5 parts less**
**Repossessed:** a copy weapon or armour worth up to 8 parts
**The debtor was rich:** **+10 parts**

startingKit: **Starting kit:** a gun for everyone: each of the four rookies starts with a scrap pistol (copy). Under rule 3, the crew may also start up to **20 parts** in debt to buy more gear.
specials: **Specials:** the gift and Rites at the normal price (30 and 20). No bots.
captiveFate: **Captive fate: Pay now.** The owner of a fighter the Ledgerhands capture **cannot refuse** the ransom: it pays the asked price at once, even if that takes its parts below 0. A crew below 0 this way buys and hires nothing, and every part it gains pays the debt first, until the debt is paid. The captive comes home.
ownTask: **Own task: Chase a debtor** (Grit, Tricky 8). Success: **13 parts**.

name: The Control Group

rules.name: Remote reboot
rules.text: The operators are safe in the bunker. The crew's breaking tests start only once **three quarters** or more of its fighters (rounded up) are down, captured or gone, instead of half. At the start of each round, one **downed bot** of the crew still on the table, with its core in it, stands up: it keeps one lasting condition of the player's choice, loses the rest, and is **Shook**.

rules.name: Research tasks
rules.text: Before deployment, roll a d6 on each list below and choose one of the two studies. If the crew completes it, one bot or volunteer who took part gains **+2 XP**. No subfaction rule can replace this one.

rules.name: The control sample
rules.text: Volunteers are cheap: **10 parts** each instead of 15. When a volunteer rolls a kept total of **5 or less** on any test or roll, every bot of the crew within 6 inches is **Hyped**: new data.

rules.name: Peer review
rules.text: The first time each round that a Control Group fighter attacks an enemy another Control Group fighter has already attacked this round, hit or miss, the attacker has **+1 die** (the finding is replicated).

subfactions.name: Replication Wing
subfactions.rule: **Cheap copies.** Bot chassis cost **5 parts less**, but every chassis is **Unreliable**: a kept total of 3 or less on a roll they make jams them. A jammed chassis has **one action** in their activation until cleared (section 7.2)

subfactions.name: Observation Wing
subfactions.rule: **Sweeping conclusions.** A Laggy bot of this crew may, instead of moving, watch: every enemy within 6 inches of them is **Announced**

subfactions.name: The Dissenters
subfactions.rule: **Negative review.** At the start of each round, if no enemy within 12 inches of any Dissenter fighter is **Shook**, one of them is: "this is not novel"

types.name: Observer
types.label: Observer (bot chassis)
types.trait: Move 5, Hands 2. Their shots ignore light cover

types.name: Lab-hand
types.label: Lab-hand (bot chassis)
types.trait: Move 4, Hands 4. Carries a downed fighter (never a bot) or a crate alone at full Move

types.name: Prototype
types.label: Prototype (bot chassis)
types.trait: Move 6, Hands 2, **always Laggy** (a beacon and the deployment zone do not help it). One copy weapon is built in, free: the player chooses it when the chassis is hired, worth up to 8 parts. It takes no Hands and no set, and it cannot be taken or prompted off

types.name: Volunteer
types.label: Volunteer (a human)
types.trait: Signed the waiver: if they end the battle down and left behind, they roll the **gentle** table anyway (the Control Group collects its subjects)

ownTaskTable.Result: **The experiment escaped.** It is on Ballast now. Lose **3 parts** in containment
**A volunteer read the form.** One volunteer of the crew is **Sore**, and furious
**Inconclusive.** Further research is needed: the fighter makes the task's test once more at once (no second table roll)
**Published,** and cited by the Replication Wing many times. The crew gains **Reliable**
**A core remembers something it should not.** One bot of the crew gains **+2 XP**
**Paradigm shift.** **+6 parts**, and the ethics board signs it off as "broadly humane": the crew gains **Merciful**

startingKit: **Starting kit:** any of the four free rookies may be a bot chassis instead (any of the three; a Lab-hand pays its 5 parts over a rookie, section 9.1), and the crew has two relay beacons and a spare cell (old stock).
specials: **Specials:** bots (Observer 15, Lab-hand 20, Prototype 15 parts); volunteers 10 (15 if the crew gave up rule 3 for its subfaction's rule, as the Replication Wing may); relay beacons 6. Rites at the normal price (20). **No psions:** every volunteer is human.
noWords: **No Words.** The Control Group swears no Words. Its fighters earn experience from research tasks instead. A table result that gives a Word (an injury, a story event, a task) does nothing for a Control Group crew.
captiveFate: **Captive fate: Experiment on them.** The captive vanishes into the bunker. One bot of the crew gains **+2 XP** from the findings, on top of half the price.
ownTask: **Own task: Run an experiment** (Tech, Tricky 8). Success: one bot gains **+2 XP**. Volunteers may run it too; nobody tells them what it was.

name: Hollowood

rules.name: The stunt double
rules.text: When a hit lands on a Hollowood fighter who **already has a lasting condition**, and their save has failed, a **Stunt double** of the crew within 3 inches may spend their reaction **before the consequence is rolled**: the hit goes to the double at the same severity, who rolls their own save and the consequence. The star takes no effect, and takes the credit. No subfaction rule can replace this one.

rules.name: Superfans
rules.text: An enemy who attacks an **Action star**, in melee or with a shot, first makes a **Routine (6) Nerve test**, at most once a round each. On a failure, in melee they are **Flustered**; with a shot they are **Shook**, so that shot is rolled at -1 die (they wanted an autograph). Bots and fighters with no Nerve ignore it.

rules.name: It was real!
rules.text: An enemy who suffers a hit from a Hollowood fighter's old-stock weapon (a hit that gets through any save) is **Flustered**: they thought it was a prop.

rules.name: Box office
rules.text: After each battle, the crew gains **2 parts** for each **spectacular** hit or Press its fighters landed on an enemy (section 5.5), and the fighter who landed it is **Hyped** at once: the clip sells.

subfactions.name: Reality Productions
subfactions.rule: **Staged drama.** When a Reality fighter puts an enemy down, they are **Announced** and **Hyped**: the camera finds them, and they play to it

subfactions.name: Streaming Platforms
subfactions.rule: **Autoplay.** When a Streaming fighter puts down an enemy, one ally within 6 inches may immediately Move up to 2 inches: the next episode starts by itself

subfactions.name: Festival Auteurs
subfactions.rule: **The director's call.** At the start of each round, while the Director is standing, they name one ally within 6 inches and the player rolls a d6 for the word: **1-2 "Move!"**, **3-4 "Attack!"**, **5-6 "Hold!"** (no Move action). If the ally obeys in their next activation they are **Hyped**; if not, **Flustered**. An "Attack!" for an ally with no enemy they could attack is rolled again. The crew never evacuates: a director does not leave a set

subfactions.name: Franchise Studios
subfactions.rule: **The formula.** A Franchise fighter who takes the same two actions in the same order as in their previous activation (Move then Attack, say) has **+1 die on every roll** in that activation. A reaction does not change it. An **Aim** never counts: an activation with an Aim in it earns no bonus, and the first activation of the battle has no previous one

types.name: Action star
types.label: Action star
types.trait: +1 die on attacks while **Announced** (they play to the camera)

types.name: Expert
types.label: Expert
types.trait: **"I played one."** Once per activation, before an attack or test of their own, the Expert says what they once played: that roll is made as if the rating were **2**. On a kept total of **9 or less** it fails anyway (a test fails, an attack does nothing), and the Expert is **Shook** and **Flustered**: the scene was cut. **Improv:** when the Expert Improvises a prompt, the machine takes them literally only on a kept total of 2 or less

types.name: Stunt double
types.label: Stunt double
types.trait: Takes the hit for a star (rule 1), with **+1 save die** on it, even with no armour: they know how to fall. **Uncredited:** when a Stunt double puts an enemy down, the XP goes to the nearest Action star instead (if none took part, it is lost), and a Stunt double can never take a title

types.name: Director
types.label: Director
types.trait: The crew's captain by default. As a Use action, shouts "Cut!": every ally within 6 inches loses **Announced**, and one of them loses a Shook token. **The camera:** the Director always carries a camera (free, Hands 1; it cannot be sold, dropped or taken, and it stays with the crew for the next Director). It fills one of their two sets with one Hand to spare, so with the camera in use they can hold one one-handed weapon, not a rifle; changing sets is a Use action as usual. While the Director is standing and has the camera in use, an allied Hollowood fighter who gives an enemy a **lasting condition** is **Hyped**, and an enemy within 6 inches of the Director who gives a fighter a lasting condition is **Announced**: the camera loves whoever draws blood

ownTaskTable.Result: **A stunt went wrong.** The stunt double was not on set. The fighter is **Sore**
**Recast.** The part went to someone taller: write the taller actor as a **rival** (section 14.8)
**Straight to slop.** Nobody watched it, and Chet Jippity says it is their best work yet. The fighter starts the next battle **Hyped**
**A fan base.** The crew gains **Showboats**
**Merchandise:** **+2 parts**, and the crew gains a **lead**
**Picture of the Year** at the Annual Improvement Awards (it beat a harvest figure): **+3 XP**

startingKit: **Starting kit:** real props: one old-stock weapon worth up to 18 parts, and the Director's camera. The four rookies are a **Director** (the captain), an **Action star**, an **Expert** and a **Stunt double**.
specials: **Specials:** the gift and Rites at the normal price (30 and 20). No bots. A crew has **at most one Director**; later hires may be any other type.
captiveFate: **Captive fate: Cast them.** The captive works as an extra in the background of the picture: the crew rolls once on the Shoot a picture table below (no test), on top of half the price.
ownTask: **Own task: Shoot a picture** (Nerve, Tricky 8). Success: **13 parts**.
